messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: web hosting options?
parts:
One option is go with Google Apps. We can register
a domain and control our URLs and even use gmail
on our own e-mail names.

The free version has ads. The "business" version
is $5/month per user. I wonder if we could just
have a single user?

There are lots of cheap web hosts out there, but
they all look pretty sketchy. We use LuxSci for
our company, and it's been reliable, but it's both expensive
($15/month for the basic plan) and relatively
bare bones.

- Bob
